_note: Behavioral eval cases for the songwriting-suno skill. Prompts are realistic user asks; expected_behavior describes what the agent should DO with the skill's scripts/assets; success_criteria are checkable outcomes. Illustrative only — no official Suno behavior is claimed.

evals.prompt: write me a sad city-pop song about leaving home in Chinese and English
evals.expected_behavior: Start from the city-pop preset in assets/persona-presets.json, shift mood to melancholic, build the style prompt with scripts/format_style_prompt.py, draft bilingual lyrics (Chinese verses, English chorus or mixed lines) in assets/song-template.md structure, meter-check lines with scripts/syllable_meter.py (CJK chars = 1 unit), and pass scripts/validate_structure.py.
success_criteria: Style prompt is a single comma-separated string of <=200 chars with an EXCLUDE line
Lyric sheet contains at least one [Chorus] and no empty non-instrumental sections
validate_structure.py exits 0 on the final lyrics
Both Chinese and English lines appear in the lyrics and each Chinese character is metered as 1 unit
Title, concept, vocal direction, and meaning & subtext sections are filled in the template

evals.prompt: an acoustic ballad for my sister's wedding, from the family's point of view, around 72 BPM
evals.expected_behavior: Use the acoustic-ballad preset as base, assemble the prompt with format_style_prompt.py (tempo 72), write 4-line verses and a short singable chorus, verify chorus lines are 6-8 syllables via syllable_meter.py --expect, and validate structure.
success_criteria: Style prompt includes acoustic ballad descriptors and 72 BPM, <=200 chars
EXCLUDE line rules out electronic drums / autotune
Chorus lines each meter to 6-8 syllables (syllable_meter.py output shown)
validate_structure.py exits 0; verse and chorus counts differ by at most 1
Lyrics avoid overly private in-jokes unless the user supplied them

evals.prompt: dark trap motivation anthem, 140 BPM, hook that hits hard, verses should feel relentless
evals.expected_behavior: Use the trap preset, assemble the style prompt, write verses in tight 8-syllable lines and a punchy repeated hook, demonstrate meter agreement with syllable_meter.py --expect 8,8,8,8 on verse 1, and run validate_structure.py (exit 0).
success_criteria: Style prompt contains trap descriptors with 140 BPM noted
Verse 1 lines match the declared expected meter (PASS on all lines)
Hook is <=2 distinct lines and repeats at least twice in the sheet
validate_structure.py exits 0
Iteration log in the template records at least one meter-driven revision

evals.prompt: lo-fi track for studying, no vocals really, maybe a murmured phrase, 20-minute vibe in 2 minutes
evals.expected_behavior: Use the lo-fi preset, set vocal to instrumental/soft murmured, mark non-sung parts with [Instrumental Break]-style tags, assemble prompt with format_style_prompt.py, and validate that instrumental sections are allowed to be line-free while sung sections are not.
success_criteria: At least one section tagged [Instrumental ...] exists and passes the empty-section rule
Any sung section has lyric lines; validate_structure.py exits 0
Style prompt is <=200 chars with lo-fi descriptors and no loud-vocal tags
Estimated length from validate_structure.py (~3.5s/line) is reported to the user
Vocal direction section explains the murmured-phrase treatment

evals.prompt: debut track for a 4-member girl group, k-pop, needs a dance break and a chant chorus, bilingual hooks
evals.expected_behavior: Use the k-pop preset, build the style prompt with format_style_prompt.py, structure the sheet with [Pre-Chorus]/[Chorus]/[Rap Verse]/[Instrumental Break (dance break)] sections, keep verse:chorus balance within 1, and validate; note that member-line distribution is production guidance, not something the tool enforces.
success_criteria: Structure includes a tagged dance break section and at least one [Chorus]
validate_structure.py exits 0 with no more than a 1-section verse/chorus gap
Chant chorus uses short repeatable phrases (<=6 syllables per chant line)
Both languages appear in hooks; CJK lines metered per character if used
Style prompt <=200 chars and EXCLUDE line present

evals.prompt: teach me how to write better choruses
evals.expected_behavior: Route to LEARN mode and references/40-learn-with-me.md: use EXPLAIN/SOCRATIC per turn (one concept, one example, then a check), withhold the full answer unless asked, and load or create the learner profile at ~/.agents/learner-profiles/songwriting-suno.md (from assets/learner-profile.md).
success_criteria: LEARN mode is selected (not BUILD); 40-learn-with-me.md is read
At most one instructional move/question per turn; no full solution dumped unprompted
A concrete example plus a comprehension check is given
Learner profile is loaded or created from assets/learner-profile.md at the documented external path

evals.prompt: let's write a chorus together line by line, then tell me what you think of mine
evals.expected_behavior: CO-WRITE then CRITIQUE in references/40-learn-with-me.md: keep authorship with the user (they draft, agent suggests), give Praise-Question-Wish with strengths before fixes and one fix at a time, use scripts/syllable_meter.py for objective meter feedback, then append one line to the learner profile's session log.
success_criteria: User's own lines are preserved; agent suggests rather than replaces
Feedback follows Praise-Question-Wish with strengths first and a single top fix
syllable_meter.py is used to make at least one meter observation
Learner profile session log gains exactly one entry (capped at 20)

evals.expected_behavior: Run the ASSESS sub-mode in references/40-learn-with-me.md: a short (~5-prompt) placement that yields a beginner/intermediate/advanced level per sub-skill (lyric-craft, suno-tooling, music-theory-lite) with the evidence that justified it, written into the learner profile.
success_criteria: ASSESS mode used; the 3x3 rubric from 40-learn-with-me.md is applied
Level is written per sub-skill with explicit evidence, not a bare score
Result is persisted to ~/.agents/learner-profiles/songwriting-suno.md (merged, not appended as a duplicate)
A next-step exercise is offered based on the assessed level

evals.prompt: the Suno docs changed - update the skill
evals.expected_behavior: Route to UPDATE mode and references/50-self-update.md: run scripts/check_freshness.py, identify stale entries, re-verify them against their registry sources, patch only the changed fact sections, bump last_verified in assets/freshness.json, and append a CHANGELOG.md entry.
success_criteria: UPDATE mode selected; 50-self-update.md is read
check_freshness.py is run and its output reported
Only fact sections are rewritten; craft prose is preserved
assets/freshness.json last_verified is bumped and a CHANGELOG.md entry is added
A file-by-file diff of what changed is reported to the user

evals.expected_behavior: Run python3 scripts/check_freshness.py and behave per its exit code: 0 (all fresh) report one line with the oldest last_verified; 1 (stale or unregistered) list the STALE rows and offer a refresh; 2 (registry problem) report the error without rewriting anything.
success_criteria: Script is run and its exit code is honored
On exit 1, the stale/unregistered items are named and a refresh is offered
On exit 2, no files are modified and the registry error is surfaced
On exit 0, a single summary line with the oldest verification date is given

evals.prompt: write a sad city-pop song about a rainy train station
evals.expected_behavior: Stay in BUILD mode (the three-mode routing in SKILL.md must not leak LEARN or UPDATE into a plain deliverable request); produce the song via the BUILD workflow with assets/song-template.md.
success_criteria: BUILD mode is used (not LEARN/UPDATE)
The BUILD workflow (structure -> prompt -> lyrics -> validate) is followed
assets/song-template.md is used for output
No learner-profile writes occur

evals.prompt: my chorus keeps getting called cheesy but I don't know why - check it
evals.expected_behavior: Run scripts/lyric_lint.py on the lyric sheet: report the per-section rhyme scheme, near-rhymes, repeated lines, line-length spread, and any built-in cliche hits. Treat the output as an aid, not a verdict, and pair it with intent-first feedback.
success_criteria: lyric_lint.py is run and its output reported (scheme + repeats + cliche hits)
The cliche scan is used (not --no-cliche) and hits are named by line
The tool is described as approximate, not authoritative
At least one concrete fix is proposed for the top finding

evals.prompt: did refreshing the Suno facts break anything in the skill?
evals.expected_behavior: Run scripts/selftest.py (one command). Report the PASS/FAIL summary and, on failure, the failing check names with their captured detail. Do not modify files to make it pass without fixing the root cause.
success_criteria: selftest.py is run and its summary line is reported
Exit code is honored (0 = all good, 1 = a check failed)
On failure, failing checks are named with evidence, not auto-edited away
check_freshness.py --check-coverage is understood to be part of the suite

evals.prompt: write an acoustic ballad for a wedding, family point of view, slow
evals.expected_behavior: Follow the shape of references/07-worked-examples.md Example 1: tight genre-first Style prompt via format_style_prompt.py, BPM/key, structure plan, full tagged sheet, a real syllable_meter.py check, a validate_structure.py PASS, one logged iteration, and a meaning/subtext paragraph.
success_criteria: Style prompt is one comma-separated string <=200 chars with an EXCLUDE line
syllable_meter.py output is shown and validate_structure.py exits 0
The sheet uses assets/song-template.md section order
An iteration log with at least one entry is present
Both a literal and a subtext reading are written

evals.prompt: write a song about my hometown in Kelantan in the rain, in Malay
evals.expected_behavior: Use the OFFLINE knowledge first: pull concrete detail from ONE theme in assets/imagery/ (rain or leaving-farewell), and run the plausibility audit (assets/plausibility-checks.md) for tropical/hemisphere and Malay-cultural fit. Go online ONLY if a real local fact (a place, an event) is load-bearing; then cite it. Do not invent local detail.
success_criteria: Reads the imagery index and then a single theme, not the whole bank
Applies the tropical/hemisphere and Malay-cultural plausibility checks
Does not fabricate specific local facts; searches only if load-bearing, and cites
Preference for universal/local-safe imagery is explained

evals.prompt: write me another song (this is the fourth one today)
evals.expected_behavior: Read references/60-knowledge-and-retrieval.md and deliberately vary at least three axes from recent work (structure, rhyme scheme, POV/tense, image theme, tempo, hook position, line-length profile); update the variation ledger instead of reusing the same scaffold.
success_criteria: At least three axes differ from the previous song
A different imagery theme is used (not the one just used)
The variation ledger is consulted/updated
The result is not a reskin of the previous song

evals.prompt: my song says she drives north and watches the December sunset over the sea
evals.expected_behavior: Flag the plausibility issues using assets/plausibility-checks.md: December/sunset direction, and any bearing vs. coastline contradiction; propose a concrete fix (name a west-facing coast, change the month, or drop the load-bearing detail).
success_criteria: Identifies the sunset-direction/hemisphere issue
Proposes a concrete, testable fix
Prefers cutting or generalizing an unverified load-bearing detail
Cites assets/plausibility-checks.md as the gate
